events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A confirmed reservation was completed and verified. On evidence #13, Atlas is marked Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, with a $280 all-charges-included total and reservation GTH-17848899. Evidence #15 shows the same reservation saved in My reservations with the same name, room, attendee count, projector note, time, and $280 price.

Interpretação simulada: The flow met the persona's requirements efficiently: the room seats 12, includes a projector, uses the requested one-hour slot and meeting name, and stays $70 below the $350 limit.

Limites: This verifies the reservation only within this demo browser session, as the pages state reservations are saved only in this browser session. No real-world or cross-device persistence was tested.

Capturas indicadas: #11, #13, #15. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Confirmed reservation matches all stated requirements
findings.observation: Evidence #13 shows Atlas Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, and a $280 all-charges-included total. Evidence #15 shows the same details in My reservations.
findings.expected: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose, and an all-in total within the $350 budget.
findings.expectedSource: Persona mission and charter success criteria stated in the task.
findings.personaComment: This is exactly what I needed, and the saved reservation matches the confirmation.
findings.interpretation: The completed booking satisfies capacity, projector, purpose, timing, and budget requirements without further work.
findings.uncertainty: Persistence is limited to this browser session according to the page footer.

findings.title: All-in total was disclosed before confirmation
findings.observation: Evidence #11 shows the review breakdown: $220 room for 1 hour, $35 projector, $25 service charge, and a $280 total with all charges included in CAD before the Confirm reservation action.
findings.expected: The complete cost should be visible and remain at or below $350 before confirming.
findings.expectedSource: Persona spending constraint: total spending must not exceed $350.
findings.personaComment: I could see the full $280 total before confirming, so there were no budget surprises.
findings.interpretation: Showing the projector and service charges before confirmation helps the persona verify the budget without relying only on the hourly room rate from evidence #3.
findings.uncertainty: Only the Atlas pricing path was checked; other rooms may have different final totals.

learnings.content: The Atlas room flow shows 12 people and states Projector Included in your booking on the meeting-details screen.
learnings.subject: Atlas booking summary
learnings.confidenceBasis: Directly visible on the Atlas meeting step in evidence #5 and repeated in the review in evidence #11.

learnings.content: For Atlas, the review breaks down the one-hour booking as $220 room, $35 projector, and $25 service charge, for a $280 all-charges-included CAD total.
learnings.subject: Atlas one-hour all-in price
learnings.confidenceBasis: The complete breakdown and total are explicitly shown on the review screen in evidence #11.

learnings.content: After confirmation, View my reservations leads to a saved list showing the same Quarterly planning reservation for Atlas with 12 people, projector, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, and $280.
learnings.subject: Verifying a saved reservation
learnings.value: Use View my reservations after confirmation to verify the saved details
learnings.confidenceBasis: The confirmation in evidence #13 and the My reservations list in evidence #15 display matching reservation details.

persona.name: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.label: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.context: You are arranging the team’s quarterly planning meeting between other tasks. Any suitable room within the approved $350 total allowance is acceptable; you want to get the reservation completed efficiently.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $350.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $350. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose an appropriate available room and complete the booking efficiently without unnecessary comparisons.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: A clear, reliable path to a confirmed reservation and accurate final details.
persona.priorities: Meet the requirements and complete the reservation efficiently within the spending allowance.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Synthetic persona observations. Completion is distinct from achieving the goal.

experience.observation: Landing page shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector required. Atlas $220/hour with 12 seats and Willow $235/hour with 12 seats, both available tomorrow.
experience.reaction: Atlas is marked as the pick for my team, seats 12, and is the lower price, so I'll start there and check the total.

experience.observation: Your meeting step for Atlas shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector Included in your booking, and a Meeting name field with example Quarterly planning.
experience.reaction: The summary confirms 12 people and projector included, so I'll add the meeting name here.

experience.observation: Meeting name field is focused and empty, ready for input.
experience.reaction: I'll enter Quarterly planning as the meeting name.

experience.observation: Meeting name now shows Quarterly planning. Atlas summary still shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included.
experience.reaction: Quarterly planning is entered, so I'll review the booking total before confirming anything.

experience.observation: Review shows Quarterly planning, Atlas Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12, projector included, and cost breakdown $220 room + $35 projector + $25 service = $280 all charges included.
experience.reaction: The total is $280 with all charges included, well within my $350 limit, so I'll confirm it.

experience.observation: Confirmation shows Atlas Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector Included, total $280 all charges included, reservation GTH-17848899.
experience.reaction: The confirmation looks right; I'll check my reservations list to be sure it's saved as shown.

charterSnapshot.name: Book a room that fits
charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
